situations.when: I have an idea for a change
situations.text: Get interviewed until every decision is made. New terms and decisions are written into GLOSSARY.md and ADRs as you go.

situations.when: I'm planning something that isn't code
situations.text: The same relentless interview, without touching repo docs. Good for talks, migrations or hiring plans.

situations.when: It's too big for one session
situations.text: Build a map of decision tickets, then resolve them one at a time across sessions.

situations.when: I have a spec or tickets ready
situations.text: Build it with tdd at the seams you agreed on, finishing with code-review. For a whole spec in parallel, use `/implement-spec`.
Just say “diagnose this”. Reproduce, minimise, hypothesise, instrument, fix, regression-test.

situations.when: I have a pile of incoming issues
situations.text: Moves issues through a state machine of triage roles, so each one ends up ready, blocked or closed.
Summary, before/after evidence and a call on how dangerous the merge is.

situations.when: I didn't understand the agent's reply
situations.text: Re-explains the last message using your project's own vocabulary from GLOSSARY.md.

situations.when: I'm stopping, but the work isn't done
situations.text: Compacts the conversation into a document another agent can pick up tomorrow.
A survey for deepening opportunities with an HTML report, then a grilling on the one you choose.

situations.when: I need a decision from someone else
situations.text: Turns a decision you can't make alone into a questionnaire for the right person.
